claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.item_form
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Several mechanics are gated by the weapon's current form, but the current passive/activation gating vocabulary can only express holding/wearing/wielding state, not which authored form the item is in.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Acrobatic Assist (Quarterstaff and 10-Foot Pole Forms Only)." / "Attack Deflection (Quarterstaff Form Only)." / "Ranged Weapon (Quarterstaff Form Only)."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item can change its own form, but activation phases can only attach to self, target, area, or mark. There is no honest way to direct `alter_item_kind` at the held weapon itself.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "While holding this weapon, you can take a Bonus Action to alter its form, turning it into a 6-inch rod ... or a 10-foot pole, or reverting it a Quarterstaff."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: emit_light
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The surface has no atom for creating or extinguishing bright/dim light radii from an item.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can cause it to emit green Dim Light out to 10 feet ... or you can extinguish the light"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: return_item_after_thrown_attack
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The boomerang-style return rider is a deterministic equipment movement effect not represented by any current atom.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Immediately after you make a ranged attack with the weapon, it flies back to your hand."
